deep.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
deep.score_reason: Gemini 3.8 Live发布，Google头部模型重要迭代，直接影响应用选型
entities: 流式语音生成与异步推理结果的时间对齐
deep.analysis:
这是 Google DeepMind 发布的 Gemini 3.8 Live 和 3.8 Live Extended Thinking 两个新模型，属于实时多模态交互系统的一次重要升级，核心是在保持低延迟语音对话能力的同时，首次引入了可中断的“边想边说”机制。

此前实时语音 AI 的一个核心痛点是“快”和“深”难以兼得。标准实时模型为了维持流畅对话，推理过程通常很短，遇到复杂问题（如多步推理、代码调试、需要查阅长文档后回答）时容易出错或敷衍。而擅长深度推理的模型又往往需要较长思考时间，在语音场景下会造成尴尬的沉默，打断对话的自然节奏。用户被迫在“响应快但不够聪明”和“够聪明但要等很久”之间做选择，这在客服、教育辅导、实时协作等场景中体验很差。

Gemini 3.8 Live 的技术要点在于将实时语音交互与可中断的推理过程深度整合。模型在生成语音回复的同时，可以在后台启动一个“思考进程”，当思考得出更优答案时，能够打断当前正在输出的语音，无缝切换到修正后的内容。这背后需要解决几个关键问题：一是流式语音生成与异步推理结果的时间对齐，即如何在不产生明显停顿或重叠的情况下完成内容切换；二是中断策略的智能判断，模型需要评估当前输出的置信度，只在必要时触发修正，避免频繁打断影响体验；三是 Extended Thinking 变体专门针对需要长链推理的场景做了优化，允许模型在对话间隙或用户沉默时持续推演，将结果缓存以备后续调用。整个系统仍然保持了 Live 系列一贯的低延迟特性，说明在工程上对推理调度和音频编解码管道做了大量优化。

对 AI 应用岗而言，这条资讯至少有三个可深入探讨的方向。第一是实时系统中的推理调度策略，面试中可能被问到如何设计一个既能保持低延迟又能动态插入深度推理的对话系统，这涉及异步任务管理、流式输出的状态机设计、以及用户体验层面的打断时机控制。第二是多模态实时交互的产品化挑战，语音场景下的错误修正比文本场景更敏感，如何设计降级策略、如何在模型能力与用户容忍度之间找平衡，是生产环境必须考虑的问题。第三是“思考可见性”的设计哲学，Extended Thinking 让模型的推理过程从黑箱变为可感知的等待或提示，这改变了人机交互的信任模型，面试中可以从产品设计角度讨论何时应该让用户感知到 AI 在思考，何时应该隐藏这个过程。这些点都直接关联到当前大厂在智能客服、AI 陪伴、实时协作工具等方向上的落地实践。

deep.title: How Included Health Built Federated Healthcare Agents with LangGraph and Deep Agents
deep.summary: See how Included Health used Deep Agents, LangGraph, and LangSmith to build Dot, a federated healthcare navigation agent with human handoff and clinical oversight.
deep.score_reason: 联邦式医疗Agent落地案例，含human handoff和LangGraph实践，解决生产真实问题，值得深读。
deep.analysis:
这是 LangChain 官方博客发布的一篇工程实践案例，介绍了数字医疗公司 Included Health 如何利用 Deep Agents、LangGraph 和 LangSmith 构建一个名为 Dot 的联邦式医疗导航智能体，并在其中实现了人工接管与临床监督机制。

在医疗领域，患者常常面临信息碎片化的困境：保险条款、预约排期、临床建议分散在不同系统中，传统的单一智能体架构难以同时处理这些跨域任务。更棘手的是，医疗场景对安全性和准确性有极高要求，纯自动化系统一旦出错可能造成严重后果，因此必须引入人类专家的监督与干预能力。此前的 AI 应用往往要么完全自动化、要么完全人工，缺乏一种灵活的人机协作模式，导致效率低下且风险不可控。

Included Health 的技术方案核心在于“联邦式架构”与“深度智能体”的结合。所谓联邦式架构，可以理解为将多个专业子智能体组合成一个协作系统，每个子智能体只负责自己的领域，由一个顶层调度器统一协调。他们使用 LangGraph 来构建这个多智能体系统的控制流，LangGraph 是一个以图结构定义智能体工作流的框架，允许开发者用节点和边来精确控制每一步的决策、工具调用和状态转移。Dot 内部包含多个专业子智能体，分别处理保险查询、预约安排、临床信息检索等任务，调度器根据用户意图将请求路由到对应的子智能体。Deep Agents 在这里扮演了关键角色，它让每个子智能体具备了长期规划和多步推理能力，能够自主决定调用哪些工具、按什么顺序执行，而不是简单的单轮问答。整个系统的可观测性由 LangSmith 提供，这是一款用于追踪、调试和评估 LLM 应用的工具，团队可以实时查看每个智能体的决策链路、工具调用结果以及最终输出。最值得关注的是人工接管机制的设计：当 Dot 遇到低置信度场景或涉及临床决策时，会自动将对话上下文和已收集的信息打包，无缝转交给人类临床团队，人类专家介入处理后，系统再从中断点继续运行。这种“人在回路中”的设计不是简单的审批节点，而是深度嵌入工作流的状态保持与恢复。

对 AI 应用岗的面试者而言，这个案例有多个可深入探讨的点。第一，它展示了生产级 AI 应用的核心挑战不是模型本身，而是架构设计——如何将复杂业务拆解为可管理的子任务、如何保证状态在多个智能体和人类之间可靠传递。面试中可以主动提及 LangGraph 的图结构控制流相比于传统的链式调用，在处理分支、循环和人机交互时更具优势。第二，可观测性是 AI 应用落地的必要条件，LangSmith 提供的链路追踪能力让团队能够快速定位问题、评估智能体表现，这是面试中讨论“如何保证 AI 应用质量”时的有力论据。第三，人工接管不是简单的功能开关，而是一个需要精心设计状态管理、上下文传递和恢复策略的系统工程，这体现了候选人对 AI 应用边界和风险控制的深刻理解。如果你在面试中被问到如何设计一个可靠的 AI 系统，可以引用这个案例说明：通过联邦式架构实现关注点分离，通过图结构工作流实现精确控制，通过深度智能体实现自主规划，再通过人在回路机制兜底高风险场景，四者结合才能构建真正可用的企业级 AI 应用。

deep.title: Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents
deep.summary: Large language model responses are non-deterministic, so failures in LLM agents are hard to reproduce: a failure depends on inference that is not bitwise reproducible, on tools that read changing state, and on a multi-step trajectory that a re-run rarely repeats. Record-and-replay makes a run reproducible, but existing agent tooling records runs only to trace or score them, not to test a code change against them. We present Chronicle, which records an agent run at its non-deterministic boundaries as immutable envelopes and replays it from the record. Its central operation, cut-point replay, serves a chosen subset of boundaries from the record and executes the complementary subset live with new code, turning a recorded incident into a regression test that runs in continuous integration. On a benchmark of 6 recorded failures with simulated model boundaries, recording adds 23 μs per crossing (0.008% of an assumed 300 ms model call), full replay issues zero model calls and is bit-stable across 20 repetitions, and cut-point tests fail on faulty code and pass on guarded and benign changes for all 6 incidents. In a mutation study of the guarded tools, cut-point tests catch every mutant that lets the recorded unsafe action through, while a baseline that stubs every boundary, using the same assertion, catches none. Chronicle and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle.
deep.score_reason: 解决LLM Agent回归测试中非确定性难复现的痛点，提出cut-point replay方法，直接提升Agent工程可靠性。
deep.analysis:
大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在执行任务时，其输出天然具有非确定性，这导致一个棘手的问题：一次运行中出现的失败很难被稳定复现。Chronicle 正是为解决这一问题而设计的工具，它通过一种称为“切点回放”（cut-point replay）的机制，将一次智能体运行的记录转化为可在持续集成（CI）中反复执行的回归测试。

此前的痛点在于，LLM 智能体的失败依赖多个不可复现的因素：模型推理本身不是比特级可重现的，智能体调用的工具可能读取不断变化的外部状态，而整个任务又是一个多步轨迹，重新运行几乎不可能原样复现。现有的智能体工具虽然也能记录运行过程，但目的仅限于追踪或评分，无法将记录用于验证代码变更是否引入了新的问题。换句话说，开发者缺少一种方法，能把一个偶然发生的线上事故固化为自动化测试。

Chronicle 的技术核心在于对智能体运行边界的精确控制。它首先在一次运行中，将所有非确定性边界（如模型调用、工具调用）记录为不可变的“信封”。其关键操作“切点回放”允许开发者选择一部分边界从记录中回放，而另一部分边界则用新代码实时执行。例如，开发者可以回放所有模型响应，但让工具调用走新的实现，从而检验工具代码的变更是否仍会导致之前的失败。在性能上，记录操作每次边界穿越仅增加 23 微秒的开销，相对于假设的 300 毫秒模型调用而言仅占 0.008%，几乎可以忽略。全回放模式下，系统完全不发出模型调用，且在 20 次重复实验中实现了比特级稳定。在针对 6 个已记录失败的基准测试中，切点测试能准确地在有缺陷的代码上失败，在受保护或良性变更上通过。更关键的是，在一项对受保护工具的变异研究中，切点测试捕获了每一个让已记录的不安全操作通过的变异体；而作为对比的基线方法（桩代所有边界并使用相同断言）则一个变异体都未能捕获。

对 AI 应用岗而言，Chronicle 展示了一个将非确定性系统纳入确定性测试流程的工程范式，这直接关系到 LLM 智能体应用的生产可用性。面试中可以深入讨论的点包括：如何定义和识别系统中的非确定性边界；切点回放策略如何平衡测试的稳定性与覆盖新代码的需求；以及这种机制如何与 CI 流水线集成，实现智能体应用的持续验证。此外，该工具在极端低开销下实现比特级稳定回放，体现了对性能与可重复性之间权衡的精细把控，这是构建可靠 AI 基础设施的核心能力。

mid.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
mid.summary: The widespread adoption of long-horizon agents has made model workloads increasingly input-heavy. Although prior work has substantially reduced the cost of long-context computation, prefill remains computationally expensive, and large KV caches continue to strain HBM and SSD capacity and data-transfer bandwidth. Together, these compute, storage, and bandwidth demands constitute the primary bottleneck to further lowering deployment costs. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. With its Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture, the model activates 16B parameters per token during decode but only 8B parameters during prefill, substantially improving cost efficiency for agentic workloads. To push the limits of KV cache compression, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching. These designs reduce its global KV cache footprint (always in HBM) to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Further, through a dedicated deployment optimization known as SWA Bounded Replay, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces its persistent KV cache footprint (always on SSD or in host memory) to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Despite its much smaller KV cache footprint, the model delivers substantially better performance than the baseline.

paper.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
paper.summary: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-lin

paper.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
paper.summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held. Naive offloading to SSD does not help on its own, because layer N+1's experts must be chosen before layer N's output exists, so the reads cannot start early enough to hide behind compute. We present Edge0, a streaming MoE inference engine that closes the gap with a prerouter: a per-layer head predicts the next layer's routing one token ahead, and the prediction is consumed as the routing itself, so the staged expert set equals the routed set and nothing is dropped. An unmerged recovery LoRA, trained on the student path, pays back the quality lost to int4 quantization and routing replacement. On a single 24GB machine, Edge0 serves a 35B MoE at 20tok/s inside 3GiB of peak active memory, within a few points of its fp16 teacher on average across five public benchmarks. An 8B tier runs on the same framework, and the framework, checkpoints, and adapters are open source.

paper.title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
paper.summary: In reinforcement learning for large language models, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) commonly uses a critic to estimate state values and reduce the variance of policy updates. However, we uncover a systematic failure mode in PPO critics, which we call Value Flattening: state values, estimated from multiple Monte Carlo continuations, change sharply across intermediate states while critic predictions remain comparatively flat. We further observe this phenomenon in a controlled FrozenLake environment and find that it becomes more pronounced as the state space grows. Our theoretical and empirical analyses relate Value Flattening to an implicit variance penalty in the critic loss and redundant updates from temporally correlated states with similar gradients. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SParse Proximal Policy Optimization (SP^3O), which applies the value loss to only a few well-separated states in each response to mitigate both effects. Experiments on Qwen3-Base show that SP^3O with only three states supervised per response can mitigate Value Flattening and consistently improve the learned policy across model sizes and evaluation suites. Together, our results identify Value Flattening as an important yet overlooked failure mode of critic learning in standard PPO and show that a simple sparse supervision strategy can mitigate it.

paper.title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
paper.summary: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall.
